description: This file implements a Flutter widget called TransactionsScreen, which displays a list of transactions with filtering options (All, Income, Expenses). It interacts with provider-based state management to fetch and filter transactions, and uses custom widgets like TransactionCard to display individual transactions.

classes.name: TransactionsScreen
classes.description: A StatelessWidget that displays a list of wallet transactions, with filter chips for All, Income, and Expenses, and a refreshable list view.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for the transactions screen, including filter chips and a list of transactions.
